notes.title: Patch Ready with Bug Fixes and Changes
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, conquerors of hell! [/p][p][/p][p]The infernal cauldron where the patch with bug fixes was brewing has finally boiled over. Catch this freshly prepared update![/p][p][/p][p]We not only fixed bugs, but also added a few improvements.
[/p][p][b]What’s Fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bug when hitting Viking’s Ice Wall counted as damage to the hero.[/p][/*][*][p]Game freezing after losing on the second difficulty level.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug causing the battle with the Witch to never end.[/p][/*][*][p]Issue with the game not launching for some users.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual bug where the Fireball animation didn’t show during using the Fireball Scroll.[/p][/*][*][p]Error where enemy deaths weren’t counted correctly for the “Whisperer” achievement.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where the hero’s death on the back tile from poison didn’t end the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where you could only exit battle via the “Surrender” button.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual bug where the blizzard effect in world 3 didn’t fully disappear after the boss’s death.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where the challenge in mission 6 of world 5 didn’t correctly register the condition.[/p][/*][*][p]The red troll Oni in world 2 no longer heals while stunned.[/p][/*][*][p]Stun status on the Devil now displays correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Hero status now appears when “Misfortune” is applied by the Devil.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]In addition:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added dialog pop-in animations during tutorials.[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltips when hovering over hero portraits in the upgrade shop between levels.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now see which stats were previously upgraded for each character.[/p][/*][*][p]Added dynamic enemy stat updates at the start of a new turn. For example, the ghost’s invulnerabilities change each turn. Previously, you had to reselect the target and click the ghost at the start of the turn to see updates; now they refresh automatically. This will help you make fewer mistakes when positioning heroes and winning battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed idle animation for the mirror copy of the Abyss Samurai Level 2 boss.[/p][/*][*][p]Devil now shows the correct text when entering the fourth phase.[/p][/*][*][p]Slight balance changes: Hunter’s poison in the second stance now deals less damage each turn, and the upgrade now costs a little more.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Viking’s portrait in the upgrade shop when upgrading health.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Update your game, play, and don’t forget to leave feedback if you haven’t already.[/p][p]
[/p][p]With respect,[/p][p]The Guards II: Chaos in Hell Team[/p][p]
[/p]

tags.bug: Bug when hitting Viking’s Ice Wall counted as damage to the hero.
Game freezing after losing on the second difficulty level.
Bug causing the battle with the Witch to never end.
Issue with the game not launching for some users.
Visual bug where the Fireball animation didn’t show during using the Fireball Scroll.
Error where enemy deaths weren’t counted correctly for the “Whisperer” achievement.
Bug where the hero’s death on the back tile from poison didn’t end the game.
Bug where you could only exit battle via the “Surrender” button.
Visual bug where the blizzard effect in world 3 didn’t fully disappear after the boss’s death.
Bug where the challenge in mission 6 of world 5 didn’t correctly register the condition.
The red troll Oni in world 2 no longer heals while stunned.
Stun status on the Devil now displays correctly.
Hero status now appears when “Misfortune” is applied by the Devil.

tags.feature: Added dialog pop-in animations during tutorials.
Added tooltips when hovering over hero portraits in the upgrade shop between levels.
You can now see which stats were previously upgraded for each character.

Added dynamic enemy stat updates at the start of a new turn. For example, the ghost’s invulnerabilities change each turn. Previously, you had to reselect the target and click the ghost at the start of the turn to see updates; now they refresh automatically. This will help you make fewer mistakes when positioning heroes and winning battles.

tags.bug: Fixed idle animation for the mirror copy of the Abyss Samurai Level 2 boss.
Devil now shows the correct text when entering the fourth phase.

tags.balance_change: Slight balance changes: Hunter’s poison in the second stance now deals less damage each turn, and the upgrade now costs a little more.

tags.bug: Changed Viking’s portrait in the upgrade shop when upgrading health.

notes.title: Play the Free Prologue of Guards II! 7 Missions and Hardcore Mode Await You!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today marks the launch of the free game Guards II: Prologue! This is a turn-based tactical game that will take you on dangerous adventures deep into Hell.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2958580/Guards_II_Prologue/ 

Lead a team of four fearless heroes and embark on an epic journey. You’ll traverse several hellish worlds inspired by terrifying legends from cultures around the world.

Get ready for seven challenging missions filled with confrontations against the ruthless denizens of Hell! Use the unique abilities and talents of your heroes to bring order to Hell and defeat the cunning boss.

[previewyoutube=voq2YPliga0;full][/previewyoutube]

In Guards II: Prologue, you’ll find:
[list]
[*] A team of four heroes with unique attack types and abilities. 
[*] An original turn-based combat system that will truly make you think about your strategy.
[*] Magical items and runes to assist your team in tough battles.
[*] Three distinct biomes with a variety of foes inspired by myths and legends from different cultures.
[*] An especially challenging mode that requires you to handle a massive wave of enemies in a single run.
[/list]
Play Guards II: Prologue, join our [url=https://discord.gg/m6rnQMmtM2]Discord[/url], and don’t forget to add the main game, Guards II: Chaos in Hell, to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2958570/Guards_II_Chaos_in_Hell/ 

Show your courage and strategy in Guards II: Prologue—bring chaos to Hell! 

Best regards,  
The Guards II: Chaos in Hell Team

notes.title: The free prologue for Guards II: Chaos in Hell is launching on March 20th!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve got some fantastic news! On March 20th, you’ll be able to dive into the free prologue for Guards II: Chaos in Hell, where you can experience the fiery embrace of hell's flames firsthand.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2958580/Guards_II_Prologue/

Get ready to sweat as you tackle seven levels and one hardcore mode! We hope you enjoy it, and while you’re gearing up for those challenging tactical battles, let’s walk you through the ins and outs of Guards II: Prologue.

[h3][b]Gameplay Basics[/b][/h3]
It's pretty straightforward. You have four heroes and four slots on the battlefield where they start at the beginning of each battle. To attack your enemies, just swap any two heroes!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/YTTsmzvq/image.gif[/img]

Remember, only three heroes on the front line will fight. The hero in the back row rests and recovers health.

[h3][b]Ultimate Ability[/b][/h3]
Each hero has two types of attacks: a basic attack and a super attack. When you move a resting hero from the back row to the front row, they will unleash their super ability.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/5Wxyzdn2/image.gif[/img]

Here’s what each hero does:
[list]
[*] The Wizard strikes a powerful blow and stuns the first enemy in line.
[*] The Warrior Princess throws their shield at the first enemy and gains protection for several turns.
[*] The Demon Hunter unleashes a barrage of crossbow bolts, hitting all enemies in their line.
[*] The Alchemist heals the hero with the lowest health.
[/list]
[h3][b]Speaking of Health[/b][/h3]
Keep an eye on the health bar next to your characters and their health points. When it gets critically low, the bar starts to blink.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/3YRFR8Ff/image.gif[/img]

If one of your heroes falls in battle, you’ll lose the game. You can recover a hero’s health by:
[list]
[*] Moving them to the back row.
[*] Using the Alchemist’s Ultimate Ability.
[*] Using a healing potion. More on that lower!
[/list]
[h3][b]Attack Types and Resistance[/b][/h3]

All heroes and enemies in the game have one of four attack types: Physical, Fire, Magic, and Death. Each unit is resilient and vulnerable to certain types of attacks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136096/ec75fcb79b19271529259ad01f3e05408fa90a74.png[/img]

Before the battle, study your enemies' stats and use the hero whose attack type the enemy is most vulnerable to. It makes perfect sense, but in the heat of battle, it’s easy to forget!

[h3][b]Using Items[/b][/h3]
From time to time, you’ll have a few items available to use before or during battle.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/CKXN1grZ/image.gif[/img]

Note that boost potions can only be used before a level starts. Don't forget this; strengthening one of your heroes can be a game-changer during the fight.

[h3][b]Hero Upgrades[/b][/h3]
In the prologue, you'll have access to two hero upgrade systems. Be sure to utilize both, or advancing through levels will be much tougher!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KcpWWjq1/image.gif[/img]

You’ll find a talent tree where upgrades are purchased with crystals.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/gFW2KJHN/2.gif[/img]

And temporary boosts between rounds bought with demonic essence. These are limited resources, so be strategic and enhance the hero who will be most beneficial in the next round.

We hope this simple guide helps you navigate the game more easily and maximize your enjoyment!

Add the main game to your Wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2958570/Guards_II_Chaos_in_Hell/ 

Join our[url=https://discord.gg/m6rnQMmtM2] Discord[/url] community and follow the game's page on Steam to stay updated on the latest news and announcements!

Best regards,
The Guards II: Chaos in Hell Team

notes.title: Fighter Chick, Wimp, Thug, and Gramps
notes.content:
Greetings!

We’re excited to continue sharing more about the game Guards II: Chaos in Hell. If you haven’t read our previous post about the gameplay features, feel free to check it out now. In the meantime, let’s introduce you to the first heroes of this thrilling story.

At the beginning of the game, your squad of adventurers will consist of four heroes, each with their own unique traits and ultimate abilities. The ultimate ability is activated when a hero moves from the back row to the front line.

[h3][b]Wizard  [/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/XZHF8vwG/Wizard.gif[/img]

A classic mage in a long robe, holding a spellbook. He wields magical attacks and confidently hurls spells at his enemies. His ultimate ability deals damage to the first enemy in line and stuns them for one turn.

[h3][b]Demon Hunter[/b][/h3]  

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Nn2bjH4S/Demon-Hunter.gif[/img]

A dark, mysterious figure with a hat pulled low over his eyes. It’s best not to cross his path, especially in a dark alley. Pss, buddy, would you like some holy water?  
Attack type: physical. Beware of his crossbow with sharp arrows.  
Ultimate ability: unleashes a powerful barrage of arrows, dealing damage to all enemies in line.

[h3][b]Warrior Princess[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Q3xzTR5T/Warrior-Princess.gif[/img]

A brave red-haired beauty clad in armor and a leather mini skirt. Armed with a shield, sword, and mace, she’s incredibly dangerous—especially in close combat.  
Attack type: physical. Enemies’ skulls shatter into pieces under her relentless strikes.  
Ultimate ability: throws her shield at the first enemy in line, dealing damage and gaining a barrier equal to 50% of the damage dealt.

[h3][b]Alchemist  [/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/fdTZBjCB/Alchemist.gif[/img]

A bearded fellow with a backpack full of magical trinkets.  
Attack type: fire. He throws “Molotov cocktails” at enemies, and if leveled up, he can ignite the ground beneath opponents, causing them to take damage over time.  
Ultimate ability: heals the hero with the lowest health.

Each hero has a vast nonlinear upgrade tree, allowing you to choose which skills and abilities to develop first.

By the way, a free prologue will be released soon, where you can get a feel for the game and get to know the heroes better. So be sure to add Guards II: Chaos in Hell to your Wishlist, follow the game’s page, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhjKSKRFrh]Discord[/url] to stay updated with the latest news!

Regards, 
Guards II: Chaos in Hell Team

notes.title: Gameplay Simplicity of Guards II: Devil in Details
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are starting a series of posts about the game Guards II: Chaos in Hell. Subscribe to the Steam page so you won’t miss the latest articles. You will need them because very soon you will have a chance to try your luck in this devilish meat grinder!

In the meantime, we’ll tell you about the gameplay features of Guards II: Chaos in Hell and a little bit about the characters you’ll be playing as.

[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]
Guards II: Chaos in Hell is a turn-based tactical game, so both you and your enemies take turns.

There are four heroes in your arsenal, each with their own unique qualities: attack type, method of performing a regular attack, resistance, and ultimate ability. To make a move, you must swap any two heroes.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/PcSKsZx/image.gif[/img]

Note that three heroes are on the front line attacking enemies, while the fourth stands on the back square and restores health.

It seems simple, but you'll have to really fight for every victory. It requires a lot of thinking and planning ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136096/4cac9f7587b913ef62cf55ed5d40915231805a11.png[/img]

All heroes and enemies in the game have one of four attack types: Physical, Fire, Magic, and Death. Each unit may be resistant to one of the attack types but vulnerable to the others.

The art of selecting the most effective combination of attack types and exploiting enemy defenses is a fundamental strategic component of the game.

[h3][b]Using Ultimate Abilities[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/vYZXynK/image.gif[/img]

When a hero moves from the back square forward, they unleash a super power. For example, the Alchemist can heal one of his allies with a recovery potion, the Monster Hunter can damage all enemies in the line and weaken them, and the Warrior can throw a shield and protect herself for several turns.

You can achieve victory by intelligently choosing your team's composition and order of strikes.

[h3][b]Upgrades and Skills[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136096/fd343b8eb5e68ca39076b4a49095a0600e9896ed.png[/img]

Every hero now has a unique tech tree with over 30 upgrades, each comprising 2 to 3 levels. You decide which skills to learn first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136096/d3468a7e9d0c9da51d6f7463729cbd2dce044ce8.png[/img]

Between levels, you have access to temporary hero upgrades. To upgrade your hero, you will need Demonic Essence, which is awarded as a reward for winning. This resource is limited, so you need to think carefully about which hero to upgrade to ensure victory in the next stage.

We have also added an expanded skill system. There are seven different skills available, which further expand your tactical options and allow you to create your own individual style of play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136096/79a5195999ddf8002cfaedfb00a2bdcbeedc8fdc.png[/img]

For example, at the beginning of each level, the hero can receive a Guard Spirit that boosts all resistances.

In the next posts, we'll talk more about the characters, enemies, and other features of the game.

Add Guards II: Chaos in Hell to your Wishlist and join our [url=https://discord.gg/vhbwRTJd4z]Discord[/url]!

Regards, 
Guards II: Chaos in Hell Team

notes.title: The new turn-based strategy, Guards II: Chaos in Hell!
notes.content:
You have made a deal with a demon, and now, together with a team of brave heroes, you have to travel through the five worlds of Hell and fight against hordes of infernal entities to stop the Devil himself. 

Guards II: Chaos in Hell is a turn-based tactical game with simple rules and very deep gameplay mechanics. Swap out your heroes to take turns attacking the enemy. It sounds easy enough, but in reality, each move requires careful thought and planning. 

[previewyoutube=8VkhWTBn9QU;full][/previewyoutube]

Guards II: Chaos in Hell features: 
[list]
[*] An original turn-based battle system;
[*] Eight heroes with unique abilities and combat techniques;
[*] A skill system with various variations;
[*] A branching upgrade tree for each hero;
[*] Five different otherworlds, each with unique monsters.
[/list]
Add Guards II: Chaos in Hell to your Wishlist, subscribe to the game's Steam page, and share the news with your friends! 

Regards,
Guards II: Chaos in Hell Team
